# Mity Nice Cafe

> Cuban Cafe in Tampa, Florida. Pressed Cuban sandwiches, a cafe con leche that guests call just right, breakfast, burgers and pizza, served with some jazz on the speakers.

- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Gibsonton, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Cuban sandwiches; Breakfast; Coffee
